summary: To restore from a PVC, create an AnsibleAutomationPlatformRestore with backup_source: PVC, backup_pvc and backup_dir at the top level and for controller, hub (with storage_type) and eda.
questions: How do I set backup_dir for an AAP restore?
Restore automation hub from a backup PVC

answer_card.title: Restore from a PVC
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
apiVersion: aap.ansible.com/v1alpha1
kind: AnsibleAutomationPlatformRestore
metadata:
  name: aap
spec:
  deployment_name: aap
  backup_source: PVC
  backup_pvc: aap-backup-claim
  backup_dir: '/backups/aap-openshift-backup-...'
  controller:
    backup_source: PVC
    backup_pvc: aap-controller-backup-claim
    backup_dir: '/backups/tower-openshift-backup-...'
  hub:
    backup_source: PVC
    backup_pvc: aap-hub-backup-claim
    backup_dir: '/backups/openshift-backup-...'
    storage_type: file
  eda:
    backup_source: PVC
    backup_pvc: aap-eda-backup-claim
    backup_dir: '/backups/eda-openshift-backup-...'
```
